subject: stf
title: STF.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 90 (WAM-32). STF (source transfer) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names PROG-CONT (progressional continuance); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance), TR-INFO (trans-information) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From TR-INFO: AFTD (affinity tendencies). From SPT-DY: RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). From AFTD: ATTN (attraction). From RIT-DY: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From ATTN: C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) and INFO-F (information focus).
